claims.text: Fairmont Mayakoba was the first resort built in the Mayakoba community, where construction began in 2003.

findings.quote: Fairmont Mayakoba was the first resort to be built in the Mayakoba community, which began construction in 2003.

claims.text: Accommodations are split between rooms, casitas and suites, with views of the mangroves, the canal or the Caribbean Sea depending on category.

findings.quote: The 401 contemporary accommodations are split between three categories: rooms, casitas, and suites. Depending on the room category, the views will be of the mangroves, the canal, or the Caribbean Sea.

claims.text: Rooms reflect modern Mexican design and have deep marble soaking tubs.

findings.quote: Rooms are bright and airy to reflect modern Mexican design and have deep marble soaking tubs.

claims.text: The resort has five swimming pools, three of them along the oceanfront.

findings.quote: Fairmont Mayakoba’s five swimming pools, including the three along the oceanfront

claims.text: Dining includes the Greek restaurant Gaia and Ki, a beach bar and Korean grill.

findings.quote: including the Greek restaurant Gaia, and Ki, a beach bar and Korean grill

claims.text: El Camaleón is a Greg Norman-designed 18-hole championship golf course.

findings.quote: El Camaleón at Fairmont Mayakoba is a Greg Norman-designed, 18-hole championship course

claims.text: The Dive & Water Sports Center offers scuba diving, jet ski rentals and private yacht charters.

findings.quote: the Dive & Water Sports Center, offering a wide range of water activities, including scuba diving, jet ski rentals, and private yacht charters

claims.text: Most spa treatments draw inspiration from Mayan cosmology and are based on the lunar calendar.

findings.quote: Most treatments draw inspiration from Mayan cosmology and are based on the lunar calendar.

claims.text: Valet parking is included in all stays (one car per room) and the resort has no self-park lots.

findings.quote: Valet parking is included in all Fairmont Mayakoba stays (one car per room). The resort does not have self-park parking lots.

claims.text: Cancun International Airport is about 30 miles (48 kilometers) from the resort.

findings.quote: Cancun International Airport (CUN) is located approximately 30 miles (48 kilometers) from Fairmont Mayakoba.

claims.text: Certain bookings include access to a Balam, a special assistant similar to a butler, and a select itinerary of exclusive activities.

findings.quote: Certain bookings also include access to a Balam (a special assistant, similar to a butler) and a select itinerary of exclusive activities.

claims.text: The spa garden has a grounding path lined with Melipona beehives, a cold plunge pool and a temazcal sweat lodge.

findings.quote: In the garden, guests will find a grounding path lined with Melipona beehives, a cold plunge pool, and a temazcal sweat lodge.

claims.text: Children eat free when choosing from the children's menu and have free programming at the Balam and Coatí Kids Clubs.

findings.quote: they eat free when selecting a meal from the children’s menu and have access to free programming at the Balam and Coatí Kids Clubs

claims.text: The Beach Front Suite has a private terrace with an infinity pool and ocean views.

findings.quote: Experience stunning ocean views from your private terrace with an infinity pool.

claims.text: The all-inclusive package does not include El Pueblito or the El Camaleón Golf Course.

findings.quote: El Pueblito and El Camaleón Golf Course are not included.

claims.text: Pets are not allowed in the pool or beach areas.

findings.quote: pets are not permitted in the pool or beach areas.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the remote location requires transportation planning.
